phases.name: Backend core: BDK dependencies and admin wallet infrastructure

steps.name: Add BDK workspace dependencies to Cargo.toml
steps.criteria: bdk_wallet and bdk_bitcoind_rpc are added to desktop-app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml under workspace dependencies. cargo build compiles without errors. No existing tests regress.

steps.name: Create admin_wallet infrastructure module with BDK wallet load and sync
steps.criteria: desktop-app/src-tauri/src/infrastructure/admin_wallet/mod.rs and wallet.rs exist. The module exposes functions to load a BDK wallet from a dev mnemonic using BIP-86 taproot descriptors (tr(m/86'/0'/73'/0/*) external, tr(m/86'/0'/73'/1/*) internal/change, regtest coin type 0'). Unit tests verify descriptor derivation vectors for m/86'/0'/73'/0/0 and m/86'/0'/73'/1/0. Unit tests pass via cargo test.

steps.name: Create CommitFunding trait with BitcoindSendToAddress and BdkAdminWalletMnemonic variants
steps.criteria: desktop-app/src-tauri/src/application/commit_funding.rs exists and defines the CommitFunding trait with two variants: BitcoindSendToAddress (default, uses BitcoinRpcClient::send_to_address) and BdkAdminWalletMnemonic (BDK wallet sync, build and sign commit tx with dev mnemonic, broadcast via chain RPC). Variant selection reads the COMMIT_FUNDING env var (default: bitcoind). If COMMIT_FUNDING=admin_wallet and BITCOIN_NETWORK != regtest the function returns a clear error immediately. Unit tests cover: default selection returns BitcoindSendToAddress, admin_wallet selection on regtest succeeds, admin_wallet selection on non-regtest returns error.

phases.name: Integration: wire CommitFunding into proposals and expose Tauri IPC command

steps.name: Inject CommitFunding into broadcast_commit_then_reveal in proposals.rs
steps.criteria: desktop-app/src-tauri/src/application/proposals.rs injects the CommitFunding abstraction into broadcast_commit_then_reveal. The variant is selected from the COMMIT_FUNDING env var at call time. The reveal path remains unchanged and continues to use operator_keypair. Existing commit/reveal unit and integration tests pass when COMMIT_FUNDING is unset. Negative test: insufficient balance and RPC-down scenarios surface clear structured errors.

steps.name: Add get_admin_wallet_info Tauri IPC command and register it in lib.rs
steps.criteria: A Tauri IPC command get_admin_wallet_info is implemented and registered in desktop-app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs. When COMMIT_FUNDING=admin_wallet the command returns the current Admin Wallet address and confirmed balance. When COMMIT_FUNDING is not admin_wallet the command returns an appropriate error or empty response. The Admin ID derivation path (m/84'/0'/73'/0/0) is never used to sign Bitcoin transactions.

phases.name: Frontend: minimal React UI additions and integration smoke

steps.name: Add funding mode label and Admin Wallet info to the broadcast screen
steps.criteria: The broadcast screen in desktop-app/src/screens/ displays a funding mode label (e.g. 'Admin Wallet (regtest)' vs 'Node RPC'). When COMMIT_FUNDING=admin_wallet the screen fetches and shows the Admin Wallet address and balance via the get_admin_wallet_info IPC command before the user confirms. The UI compiles without TypeScript errors (npm run build passes). Manual smoke test: launch app with COMMIT_FUNDING=admin_wallet on a running regtest node, verify address and balance appear on the broadcast screen before confirmation.
